It's a firebird from Greek mythology that is cyclically reborn. When it feels its end is near, it builds a nest of aromatic woods and spices, sets it on fire, and is consumed by the flames. From the ashes, a new, young phoenix emerges to live a new life, symbolizing rebirth, immortality, and renewal.

Other notable inventions and innovations by Tesla include the Tesla coil, rotating magnetic fields, and early developments in wireless communication and radar.

**Thomas Edison**.

He is one of the most prolific inventors in history, holding over 1,000 U.S. patents. He is best known for inventing the first practical and commercially successful **incandescent light bulb**, the **phonograph** (a machine for recording and playing back sound), and for developing early **motion picture cameras**.

**Socrates** (c. 470–399 BC) was a classical Greek philosopher credited as a founder of Western philosophy. He is best known for his **Socratic method**, a form of cooperative dialogue where participants ask and answer questions to stimulate critical thinking and illuminate ideas.

Unlike other philosophers, Socrates did not write anything down; he is known to us primarily through the writings of his student, **Plato**, and other contemporaries. He was famously executed in Athens for "corrupting the youth" and impiety.
